CallMergePhase.description:
First-class lifecycle of the immediate human merge on a paused call (17A).

SENSITIVE_REQUEST_DETECTED -> PATIENT_BEING_CONNECTED -> PATIENT_CONNECTED
-> PATIENT_HANDLING_VERIFICATION -> PATIENT_RELEASED -> AI_RESUMING.
MERGE_FAILED is the explicit failure escape (the AI is never auto-resumed).

info.description:
Amyna Core owns the case (single source of truth).

* **Public API** — used by the Relay service and other clients (Bearer service token).
* **/internal/tools/** — used by Fetch agents and the voice manager; scoped per caller.
* **/relay/webhook** — signed (HMAC-SHA256) idempotent patient events.
* **/voice/telnyx/webhook** — signed (Ed25519) Telnyx call events: completes the
  insurer ⇄ xAI SIP bridge on ``call.answered``, ends the call on ``call.hangup``.

Prototype: synthetic data only, not HIPAA-ready.
info.title: Amyna Core

post.description:
Signed, idempotent patient event from the Relay service.

Headers: ``X-Amyna-Timestamp`` (unix seconds) and
``X-Amyna-Signature: v1=<hex HMAC-SHA256(CORE_WEBHOOK_SECRET, "{ts}.{raw body}")>``.
Register a recorded visit (requires a granted `recording` consent).
Attach the transcript; the Visit Agent logic then extracts evidence.

schema.title: Response Get Visit Evidence Visits  Visit Id  Evidence Get

post.description: Start the insurer call. 409 unless the dispute is APPROVED with stored authorization.

Signed call events from Telnyx (Ed25519; no bearer token).

Headers: ``Telnyx-Timestamp`` (unix seconds) and ``Telnyx-Signature-Ed25519``
(base64 Ed25519 over ``timestamp`` + raw body; account public key from Mission
Control). ``call.answered`` for the insurer leg bridges the call to xAI's SIP
URI (transfer); ``call.hangup`` ends the Core call. Acked 200 per the Telnyx
delivery contract.

schema.title: Response Telnyx Webhook Voice Telnyx Webhook Post

post.description:
Signed ``realtime.call.incoming`` from xAI for a bridged SIP call (task 15).

Headers (verified against the current xAI SIP docs): ``webhook-id``,
``webhook-timestamp``, ``webhook-signature``. The payload's ``data.call_id``
is attached to our call via the ``x-amyna-call-id`` SIP header we set on
Telnyx's transfer; then the realtime WebSocket attaches with ``?call_id=``.

schema.title: Response Xai Incoming Call Webhook Voice Xai Webhook Post
